candidates.label: B066-dec0A (defense fix)
candidates.change: A only: the 1-turn no-op 'jmp short phoenix_init' (it jumps to the next instruction) is replaced by 'mov word [0000h],01FFFh' (same turn count, +4 bytes). Arena 0000h then reads FF 1F CC CC, the INT87 signature of the 2025 searchers OpcodeHunter1, 2B2Team1/2 and ADDvanced1/2. They search forward from DI=0, so address 0 is the first match and their replacement lands there instead of on our anchors or B's worker template. Source agent2/night/scratch/B066/dec0A.asm.
candidates.groupNotes: Not screened (budget used). Threat 83rh4 (1 copy, 8 cohorts per threat, 480 battles/arm): ALL +0.0573 [0.0212,0.0934] W/L 13/3; OH_real +0.047 [0.007,0.087] 5/1; TB_real (2B2Team) +0.106 [0.013,0.200] 5/2; ADD_real (ADDvanced) +0.019 [0.001,0.037] 3/0. Most of the gain is in B's score. Searcher team scores drop: 2B2Team 0.2375 -> 0.1625, OpcodeHunter 0.165 -> 0.142, ADDvanced 0.194 -> 0.175. Expected effect on field S is about +0.005 ALL, because only 5/50 cohorts contain a searcher. The general cost is unmeasured: turn count is unchanged, and the B size change in padB left every non-searcher cohort of field S bit-identical, but a screen is still needed.

threatFindings.threat: Published INT87 searchers for FF 1F CC CC (call far [bx] followed by untouched arena): 2025 GGN_OpcodeHunter1 (forward from DI=0 at its turn ~50, replacement CC CC 00 00), TOM_2B2Team1/2 (forward, turn ~100+ after loop delays), HRZ_ADDvanced1/2 (forward from DI=0, replacement CC CC CC CC). Also 2024 online/live BZV_PastRAMa, TOM_ATO1, HRZ_JMP2HELL2 and HLS_segment_fault1 (live), and 2023 Assembly_Beasts, Cookies_Army and Mydoom. None in the 2024 final versions (segment_fault final searches FF 18 CC CC / CC CC FF 1C; ATO2 final searches 89 D8 FF E3).
threatFindings.evidence: Static scan agent2/night/scratch/B066/scan.mjs, which matches rev0 padded with CCh as it sits in the arena, plus dis86 resolution of the ADDvanced sites (AX 1FFF, DX=AX=CCCC). Prevalence: 3/75 teams in field2025, 4/42 in field2024live, 0/12 in 2024 final; 5/50 field S cohorts contain one. Correction to B056: their scan matched only inside the binary, but rev0 B ends with FF 1F (worker call far [bx] at offset C8h), so in the arena B's tail reads FF 1F CC CC.
threatFindings.impact: On average these searchers take points from rev0 mainly through B (anchors / zombie template). Exact base cost cannot be read from my jobs because base-vs-neutered comparisons are unpaired (2B2Team cohorts: base 0.491 vs 0.780 with neutered 2B2Team, different fillers). A lower bound comes from the paired decoy gain: +0.057/battle in searcher cohorts (+0.106 vs 2B2Team).

threatFindings.threat: B's own arena tail FF 1F CC CC acts as a natural decoy that absorbs these searches (removing it exposes anchors)
threatFindings.evidence: padB removes the tail match. Threat hzq6i -0.042 [-0.064,-0.020] 0/12. In screen twd8z only searcher cohorts change, all negative (-0.0058 ALL). The neutered-searcher control asd0g is ~0 apart from cohorts with real searcher fillers.
threatFindings.impact: ~-0.06 per searcher cohort if removed. Do not reorder or pad B's tail without adding a decoy elsewhere.

recommendation: Screen dec0A (A only, 198 B, sha 2fadd3de) on field S, then consider it for confirmation as a defense add-on. It is turn-neutral and specific to the FF1FCCCC searchers (+0.057 in their cohorts, 13/3), and should combine cleanly with B054 fix2steal (B), B059 zph (B) and A003 C1. Do not promote padB. Keep B's FF 1F CC CC tail as it is: it is a working decoy (-0.0058 on field S when removed). Coordinator note: B056's 'archived searchers match rev0: not-reproduced' should be amended, because FF1FCCCC searchers in 2025 do match B's arena tail and our dwell anchors.
notes: Neutered binaries were made by changing DX CCCC to CDCC before each INT87 (bin/OHn1 3 sites, TBn1 2, TBn2 1). OHn2 is an unmodified copy of OpcodeHunter2, which has no FF1F search. dec0A writes 1FFFh to [0000h] with DS=arena before phoenix_init. Rare side effect if a warrior is loaded at 0000h.
